51125694.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to VBC complex (unknown origin) by ITC assay

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: The binding affinity of the newly synthesized compounds to VHL was evaluated by two orthogonal assays: a direct binding assay using isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC) and a competition assay using fluorescence polarization (FP), which monitored the compound’s ability to displace a fluorescently-labeled high-affinity HIF peptide (Table 1). The results from both assays revealed an excellent agreement on the compounds’ affinity rank (Fig. 3A and B).
original_paragraph.Figure 3 caption: Fig. 3. Biophysical characterization of compounds 1–4 binding to VHL. A) Competitive fluorescence polarization binding assay curve of compounds displacing a 20-mer FAM-labeled HIF-1α peptide bound to VBC (Kd = 3 nM). B) ITC direct titration of compounds into VBC protein complex. C) Predicted EMM-GBSA versus experimental ΔH for compounds 1–4 binding to VBC.
